items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You mean people like Paul Quinichette or . . . ? Yeah, they just wanted to really copy him.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Well, you had a few diehards who just wanted to play like Hawk. Then you had a few diehards who just wanted to play like Pres.
You mean people like Paul Quinichette or . . . ?
Yeah, they just wanted to really copy him. I never was – I don’t want to copy anybody, try to steal anybody’s style. The sound was different, but I didn’t want to steal anybody’s style.
